title: Materia
description: Explore an evidence-graded, study-cited knowledge graph from body parts to conditions, remedies, compounds, and research.
markdown: Materia is an ad-free reference, not a diagnosis or treatment service. Use the body explorer or the public indexes to navigate the cited corpus.

title: About Materia
description: Why Materia connects interactive anatomy with evidence-graded remedies and primary research.
markdown: Materia aggregates public evidence so readers can inspect how a remedy, condition, compound, and study connect. It does not replace clinical care.

title: Interaction and safety checker
description: Check a local list of herbs, supplements, and drugs for recorded interactions, duplicate compounds, and shared risks.
markdown: The checker runs in the browser against Materia's cited interaction graph. It does not diagnose, prescribe, or guarantee that an unlisted combination is safe.

title: Compounds
description: Browse the active compounds behind Materia remedies and follow their mechanisms and biological targets.
markdown: Each compound page connects a named constituent to the remedies that contain it.

title: Conditions
description: Browse conditions, body-part relationships, red flags, and evidence-graded remedy claims.
markdown: Condition pages describe the cited evidence and surface red flags that should prompt professional care.

title: Data and knowledge-graph export
description: Download the public Materia knowledge graph as structured JSON.
markdown: The JSON export contains the same public collection nodes and typed relationships used by the website. It is a data resource, not medical advice.

title: Medical disclaimer
description: Understand the limits of Materia's educational, evidence-aggregation content.
markdown: Materia provides general educational information. It is not medical advice, diagnosis, or a substitute for a qualified clinician.

title: Frequently asked questions
description: Answers about Materia's evidence grades, citations, safety posture, and data sources.
markdown: The FAQ explains how to interpret the reference and what Materia deliberately does not claim.

title: Evidence methodology
description: How Materia assigns evidence grades per remedy and condition and links every efficacy claim to citations.
markdown: Grades apply to one remedy-condition claim at a time. Efficacy and safety are separate, and every efficacy claim must cite at least one study or source.

title: Body parts
description: Browse anatomical entry points into Materia's condition and remedy graph.
markdown: Body-part pages connect anatomy to related conditions and onward to cited remedy evidence.

title: Remedies
description: Browse herbs, supplements, nutrients, chemicals, practices, medicines, and drugs in the Materia corpus.
markdown: A remedy page separates evidence by condition, preserves negative findings, and lists recorded safety information.

title: Search Materia
description: Search public conditions, remedies, body parts, and compounds.
markdown: Search is a public navigation tool over the checked-in corpus. Agents can also follow the collection templates in the agent catalog.
